title: Assignment 17 · Standard forms and adhesion
summary: Standard forms and adhesion. Assigned readings and principal cases for this class.
notes:
Carnival Cruise Lines, Inc. v. Shute: The Supreme Court enforced the Florida forum-selection clause in the cruise ticket under federal admiralty law, treating notice as conceded and preserving scrutiny for fundamental fairness.

Graham v. Scissor-Tail, Inc.: A powerful concert promoter could still be an adherent to an industry form; the arbitration requirement was expected, but selecting the other side’s union as arbitrator was unconscionable.

Doe v. Great Expectations: The dating service had to refund the customers’ payments because its contracts violated statutory requirements and it failed to disclose rights that would have affected their decisions to contract.

Additional assigned materials: Restatement § 211; Restatement of Consumer Contracts § 8; EU Directive and associated Notifications.
